BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, in Amos's picture of the remnant: as the shepherd takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria. Damask is the fabric of the wealthy, named for the city that wove it, and the remnant is as small as a scrap of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a sober picture of the remnant: what is saved is as small as a piece of cloth, and it is saved by the Shepherd's hand.
